heading: All offers made by you
shipmentReturned: Your shipment was returned by Omniva - register it again and enter the new barcode below.
noShippingInfoYet: No shipping info saved yet - set it up here (also saves it for next time), or do it anytime on <ProfileLink>your profile</ProfileLink>.
waitingForOtherShipping: Waiting for the other side to share their shipping info.
registerShipmentInstructions: Register your shipment yourself on Omniva's own site/app (no account with us needed there), then paste the barcode it gives you below. That barcode is what the parcel machine scans when you drop your toy off - saving it here turns it into a QR code you can pull up on your phone at the machine, and lets us know both sides have registered before either of you ships.
checkExactPrice: Check exact Omniva shipping price for {{country}}
openedInNewTab: This already opened in a new tab - pick your parcel machine over there, and once Omniva gives you a barcode, come back and paste it below.
markPostedAgain: Mark my toy as dropped off again
markPosted: Mark my toy as dropped off
awaitingOtherRegistration: Hold off dropping your toy off - waiting for the other side to register with Omniva too.
markReceived: Mark the other toy as received
tipPrompt: This trade is complete! If ToyTrader was useful to you, you're welcome to buy me a coffee - completely optional, no pressure either way.
cannotCancelAnymore: This trade can no longer be cancelled - a toy is already on its way.
confirmCancel: Cancel this trade? This cannot be undone.
enterBarcodeFirst: Enter the barcode Omniva gave you first.
invalidBarcode: That doesn't look like a real Omniva barcode - it should be 5-30 characters.
